title: DeepSeek Harness
description:
Your agency still rents five tools just to keep your agents running. One open source harness can replace the stack.

DeepSeek Harness crossed 92,000 GitHub stars in its first 24 hours for one reason: everything is a plugin and it is MIT licensed. It runs in one command, wires your own agent stack together, and you own it. No subscription, no per-token toll on every new tool.

Stop renting agent software. Run one harness, keep the margin.
